top_signals.title: Guyana’s Oil Boom Matters More Than Ever
top_signals.summary: In a surprise development, the tiny South American nation of Guyana recently emerged as a major oil exporter. In a mere four years, the former British colony of one million went from first discovery to first oil. Guyana has cemented its place among South America’s leading oil producers, pumping nearly one million barrels per day, making it the continent’s third-largest oil producer. top_signals.title: Ford Shares Climb as Profit-Rich SUVs Drive Outlook Higher
top_signals.summary:
Ford Motor Co. raised its profit outlook for the second time this year as consumers continue to snap up the automaker’s high-margin sport-utility vehicles.
The rosier forecast, revealed late Tuesday as the automaker reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings, shows how Ford is cashing in on resilient demand for SUVs and pickups, echoing a similar move by rival General Motors Co. last week.  Bloomberg's Craig Trudell joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
